input: Any commit that modifies /moves/rook_a8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to rook_a8's own key, and the same rule applies to /moves/knight_g8.text and /moves/queen_d8.text, because those agents have repeatedly gone off plan with greed.
response: always(([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/rook_a8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_g8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/knight_g8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false))
